The entire staff is simply amazing! From the wonderful veterinarians to the supportive staff, I truly couldn't ask for a better place to care for my dogs and cat.

My pets see Dr. Gonzales about 99% of the time, and she is hands down the best veterinarian I've ever had the pleasure of working with. She takes her time, thoroughly explains everything, answers questions, and genuinely cares about her patients. It's clear that everyone here truly loves animals. The entire team is compassionate and skilled. Supportive through every stage of a pet's life, including the difficult moments that come with end-of-life care.

On top of the exceptional care, their prices are some of the best I've found. I've never had an issue scheduling appointments or obtaining records, and the staff has always been helpful and accommodating. I honestly couldn't imagine taking my pets anywhere else, and I hope I never have to!

I personally prefer this location over the Ellison location, and I'm especially excited that they're adding a surgery suite! It's wonderful knowing I'll soon be able to have just about everything my pets need taken care of at one location.
Great service from a small clinic.
Very thorough and honest.

She was able to asses and try and send off slides fro. Faith's mass?/Hematoma on her left abd. She stopped the bleeding with ice,pressure a nd silver nitrate. I followed Faith during the night and she did great!
Dr. CURD will she her Monday for a recheck and CBC may Clotting studies...to make sure all is good. Thank you Dr. Curd , Lacey was there as well and is wonderful. She is kind, gentle and great with Faith, also very knowledgeable.  Ava wasn't  there but normally is and is also the best. She will go out of her way to accommodate all of your needs!... Thank you All. You are all highly recommended...

Friendly staff, they made us feel safe and comfortable. We left feeling happy and satisfied.  We are established patients and looking forward for the next visit. I'm so glad we chose Potranco Veterinary Clinic.

My 6 year old boxer mix had a full body rash causing him to be lethargic & constantly itchy. I tried for 2 weeks to help him with medicated shampoos & sprays from Petsmart but nothing helped. I called around to several vet offices in my area but all required future appointments.  Potranco vet clinic however welcomed us in the sane day. They were great with my dog & sent me home with meds, ointment, eye drops, & medicated shampoo. In only 3 days there was a huge difference & my dog was finally feeling better and acting like himself again. Thank you so much Potranco vet clinic! We truly appreciate you & your team!

I’m so grateful for the care my kitten Solo received during a very scary time when he began having seizures. The staff was compassionate, attentive, and treated him with such kindness. They helped get him stabilized and made an incredibly stressful situation a little easier. I truly appreciate everything they did for Solo and would absolutely recommend them.
Special thanks to Ava, Dylan and Dr. Burton
It was wonderful!! Very nice and very professional!!

This was one of the most upsetting and unprofessional veterinary experiences I’ve ever had. I’m a first-time kitten mom, doing my best to make sure my baby is well cared for, and I came in with a lot of questions. Instead of being supported, I was met with rudeness and passive-aggressive comments from the vet tech. She seemed visibly annoyed with me simply for asking questions — something any responsible pet owner should feel safe doing. She even contradicted herself, saying one thing and doing another, and overall made me feel like I was being a burden. It felt like she was more interested in holding a cute young kitten and upselling services than actually offering proper care and compassion.

To make things worse, I was told I could be present while my kitten had his vitals and measurements taken — but then they took him away from me without explanation. My kitten is being raised as an emotional support animal, and we are still developing our bond. Being separated in a strange, loud environment while unfamiliar people surrounded him, loudly commenting on how “cute” he was, clearly overwhelmed him. I could hear him crying through the door. It was heartbreaking for me as a new pet parent, and distressing for him. It turned what should’ve been a routine checkup into a traumatizing experience for both of us.

Throughout all of this, not a single staff member offered any empathy or support. I left the appointment feeling emotional and shaken, and the front desk staff were just as cold and disconnected. To add to the frustration, the communication across the clinic was incredibly disorganized — I was called the day after my appointment and told I needed to pick up a prescription… which I had already picked up the day before.

And if all that wasn’t enough, I’ve tried to get in contact with the clinic manager to share my concerns — but no one has followed up. When I called to check in, the receptionist told me the manager “just has a lot going on.” Honestly, shouldn’t following up with concerned clients be one of the manager’s top priorities? It’s incredibly disappointing to feel like your concerns are being brushed aside or simply ignored.

The only redeeming factor of this clinic is Dr. Sue Brown, who was compassionate, knowledgeable with my resident cat, and clearly cares about both animals and their people. Sadly, she’s only a relief vet and is rarely there — otherwise, I might have considered giving the clinic another chance.

As it stands, I’ll be taking my kitten elsewhere. This clinic is disorganized, unprofessional, and completely lacking in the empathy and care that should be at the heart of veterinary medicine. I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone — especially not fellow new pet parents.

I recently had to make one of the hardest decisions for my beloved dog, and I can’t express enough gratitude to Potranco Veterinary Clinic. From the moment we arrived, the staff showed genuine compassion and understanding. They allowed us the time and space to say our goodbyes without any rush, respecting our grief and emotions. Even though we weren’t ready to let go, their comforting presence and gentle reassurance made the process as peaceful as possible. They truly cared for our furry family member and for us as well, guiding us with kindness through an incredibly difficult moment. Thank you, Potranco Vet Clinic, for your warmth and the compassionate care you provide.
